# anthropic_memory_stores (Data Source)

Lists Managed Agents memory stores.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_memory_stores" "all" {}

output "memory_store_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_memory_stores.all.memory_stores[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived stores. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `memory_stores` (Attributes List) Memory stores. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memory_stores))

<a id="nestedatt--memory_stores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `memory_stores`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description; null when unset.
- `id` (String) Memory store id.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
